# Implementing Domain-Driven Design for Codex

Generated by scripts/build-targets.mjs from plugins/ddd-implementing/ in the guided-plugins repository (https://github.com/Nouran99/guidedplugins).

- Skills: 30 workflow and rule skills plus 6 mode skills, invoked as `$ddd-implementing:<name>` or from `/skills`.
- Subagents: 21 roles. A Codex plugin cannot activate subagents by itself, so the roles ship as files in `skills/install-roles/roles/`. Run `$ddd-implementing:install-roles` once (it copies them to `~/.codex/agents` or the project's `.codex/agents`) and restart Codex. Codex lists every installed role in each request, so install the books you use. Roles are prompts, not a sandbox; start Codex with `codex --sandbox read-only` when you want reviews that cannot write.
- Always-on rules: `dist/rules/ddd-implementing/` in the repository (`AGENTS.nano.md` or `AGENTS.mini.md`), to copy into your `AGENTS.md`.

Full instructions: docs/AGENTS_SUPPORT.md in the repository.
